title: Plan Checker
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agents for Robotics
description: Check eight pick-and-place plans before the arm moves. Each plan is a numbered list of tool calls, and you name the one problem with it or say that the plan is valid. Used in Chapter 16.

educational.topic: Task planning, task decomposition and checking a plan before it runs
learningObjectives: Examine eight pick-and-place plans written as lists of tool calls and name the problem with each, or say that the plan is valid, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Break each plan into its steps and test them against rules and against their neighbors, with the correct outcome and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Which check does this plan fail, if any?
Why does the order of the steps matter when every step is legal?
commonMisconceptions: A plan is fine if each step is individually legal
A plan that the model wrote needs no checking
The executor can fix a bad plan as it goes
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed outcomes; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Your answer
values: Uses a tool that does not exist

controls.label: Start / Check / Next plan / See score / Try again
